label: Episode 26
logline: While secretly administering a charcoal antidote to the poisoned Dowager Duchess in the dead of night, Juliana is stunned when the Duchess suddenly recognizes a distinctive family ring on her hand and fiercely demands the truth about her identity.
continuity_notes: Following her encounter with Alexander in the forest where she vowed to protect the Duchess, Juliana sneaks into the bedchamber at Ashburg Manor to deliver the remaining antidote before Rupert and Catherine's poison takes full hold.

picks.logline: While secretly administering a charcoal antidote to the poisoned Dowager Duchess in the dead of night, Juliana is stunned when the Duchess suddenly recognizes a distinctive family ring on her hand and fiercely demands the truth about her identity.
picks.hook: "Rupert and Catherine want me dead. They are poisoning me in my own bed, aren't they?"
picks.cliffhanger: "Then tell me... why is a girl of such noble spirit working as a common maid?"
picks.why_it_works: opens on a clear dramatic question; ends on a raised stake; mostly self-contained, needs one line of setup.

standalone_notes: relies on prior knowledge of CATHERINE, DOWAGER, JULIANA, RUPERT
